text: You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of work. You should never engage in action for the sake of reward.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Whenever dharma declines and the purpose of life is forgotten, I manifest myself on earth.
author: Lord Krishna

text: For a man who has conquered his mind, it is the best of friends. For one who has failed to do so, it is the greatest enemy.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Truth is one; sages call it by various names.
author: Rig Veda

text: The one who acts without attachment to the fruits of action, who is ever content, who is free from all fears — that person is ever established in God.
author: Lord Krishna

text: When one's mind and intellect are purified, and the self is constantly engaged in the divine, then true wisdom dawns.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Just as a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so too does the yogi whose mind is absorbed in meditation remain steady.
author: Lord Krishna

text: For those who worship Me with devotion, meditating on My transcendental form — to them, what has not been attained and what is not preserved, I carry.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Those who worship Me with devotion, knowing what is real and true, reach Me.
author: Lord Krishna

text: The wise man who abandons all desires and revels in the self, he alone enjoys liberation.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Abandoning all dharmas, take refuge in Me alone. I will liberate you from all sins; do not grieve.
author: Lord Krishna

text: The wise do not grieve over what has gone by, nor do they long for what is yet to come. They simply exist in the present.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Let a man lift himself by his own efforts, let him not lower himself. For he is his own friend and his own enemy.
author: Lord Krishna

text: The yogi who disciplines the mind is ever established in the divine, for he has surrendered all to the supreme.
author: Lord Krishna

text: If one is deluded, God will not save him. But if one has knowledge, God will liberate him.
author: Lord Krishna

text: The one who transcends caste and class, who sees the divine in all beings, that one has truly crossed the ocean of ignorance.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Fearlessness, purity, devotion to yoga, knowledge, straightforwardness, gentleness, truthfulness, kindness, firmness — these are the divine qualities.
author: Lord Krishna

text: The food which promotes life, strength, health, and happiness is loved by the good.
author: Lord Krishna

text: Tat tvam asi — That thou art. You are not separate from the Infinite.
author: Chandogya Upanishad

text: Tamaso ma jyotirgamaya — Lead me from darkness to light.
author: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad

text: The Lord pervades all of this universe. Whatever is, is pervaded by the Lord.
author: Isha Upanishad

text: The Self is neither this nor that. It is not born; it does not die. It is not slain when the body is slain.
author: Katha Upanishad

text: The Self is finer than the finest; it is the ground of all existence. It is the Self that one must know.
author: Chandogya Upanishad

text: All space is within the heart. The whole universe is within, and so is God.
author: Chandogya Upanishad

text: He who knows the Self as bodiless within the bodies, unchanging among the changing, great and omnipresent — he does not grieve.
author: Katha Upanishad

text: The Vedas are the breath of God. To study them is to commune with the Divine.
author: Rig Veda

text: One who has seen God's truth is freed. One who has not seen it remains bound.
author: Rig Veda

text: The gods and humans alike were created by the same Power, and in that Power do they return.
author: Atharva Veda

text: Strength is life, weakness is death. Courage is life, cowardice is death.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: In a day, if we do not fight our ignorance, we go backward. In a day that we do fight our ignorance, we go forward.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: All power is within you; you can do anything and everything. Believe that. I have proved it for you many times if you remember. Do not disbelieve.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Take the whole responsibility of your own life. The more you blame others, the more you lose peace of mind.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: The moment you feel you are above others, you have lost everything. Ego is the greatest enemy of humans.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: The greatest sin is fear. Never be afraid, never be afraid.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Give up all desire for what is not the Self. That alone is peace.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: The whole secret of existence is to find out what destiny is. To know it, you must look inside.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: God lives in every soul. The one who sees God in every being is the true devotee.
author: Ramakrishna Paramhansa

text: The mind is like a clean mirror. If it is dirty, you see nothing clearly. Clean it, and you see God.
author: Ramakrishna Paramhansa

text: God has made many religions — just as there are many paths on a mountain, all leading to the same summit.
author: Ramakrishna Paramhansa

text: The heart of the devotee is the throne of God. When the heart is pure, God sits there.
author: Ramakrishna Paramhansa

text: One who has realized the Self sees no difference between a snake and a worm, a king and a beggar.
author: Adi Shankaracharya

text: The Self is not the body, not the mind, not the senses. It is the witness, the eternal presence.
author: Adi Shankaracharya

text: Liberation is not something that comes from outside. It is the removal of ignorance about the Self that already exists.
author: Adi Shankaracharya

text: Brahman is truth. The world is illusion. The self is Brahman.
author: Adi Shankaracharya

text: The one thing you can do is to turn inward. That is the only way to know freedom.
author: Sadhguru

text: Well-being is not a luxury. It is the fundamental right of every human being.
author: Sadhguru

text: The nature of life is to flow. Anything that does not flow, rots.
author: Sadhguru

text: The one who has truly surrendered has no fear, for he has surrendered everything — including death.
author: Sadhguru

text: You are not what you think you are. What you truly are cannot be captured in words.
author: Nisargadatta Maharaj

text: The Self is not a thing that exists or does not exist. It is the very basis of all existence.
author: Nisargadatta Maharaj

text: Go back to the source — to the awareness that knows without knowing — and there you will find peace.
author: Nisargadatta Maharaj

text: The witness is the one who sees the dream. When the dream ends, the witness remains.
author: Nisargadatta Maharaj

text: Be still. It knows. It is you.
author: Ramana Maharshi

text: The Self that is in you is the Self that is in all things. Knowing this, you know everything.
author: Ramana Maharshi

text: Happiness is your nature. It is not wrong to desire it. You only err when you desire it from a particular source.
author: Ramana Maharshi

text: Who are you? That is the only question. When you truly answer it, all other questions dissolve.
author: Ramana Maharshi

text: The real Self is indestructible. It cannot be harmed by fire, nor cut by weapons, nor dried by wind.
author: Ramana Maharshi

text: Evolution is the great movement of the soul toward its own light. Every life is a step in that movement.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: The Divine is not something foreign. It is the deepest truth of your own being.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: The purpose of life is to realize that you are the same as God. There is no separation.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: Live deeply, and the light will come to you. It always comes to those who are ready.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda

text: Happiness is not a product of the world; it is a product of the soul.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda

text: Meditation is the ultimate form of self-care. It is the food of the soul.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda

text: The deepest prayer is the one where you simply surrender and let God speak through you.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda

text: God is Truth. Live in truth, and you will find God.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: The great religions of the world have all taught us one truth: there is only one God, and He speaks through many voices.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: If you truly love God, you love all of His creation without exception.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: The embrace of the mother is the embrace of God. In her love, you will find the deepest peace.
author: Amma

text: When love fills the heart, the soul becomes light as a feather.
author: Amma

text: Do not waste your life running from one thing to another. Sit down, and look within. That is where God lives.
author: Amma

text: The heart that gives freely is the heart that receives abundantly.
author: Amma

text: Serve others, and you serve God. Service is the highest form of worship.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: Forget the past and the future. Live in the present. That is where God dwells.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: The wise man does not dwell in pleasure or pain. He remains untouched by both, rooted in the Self.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: Patience is the most powerful weapon. The one who is patient will never be defeated.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: Meditation is not the act of thinking nothing. It is the act of seeing everything without attachment.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: Know thyself, control thyself, uplift thyself — these three are the foundation of life.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: The more deeply you love, the more deeply you know. Love is the supreme knowledge.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: Only love can heal what has been broken. Only compassion can mend what has been torn.
author: Ramakrishna Paramhansa

text: Pray not for material things but for the wisdom to know what is truly needed.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: The Atman is the source of all joy. To find joy, look within — not in the world.
author: Isha Upanishad

text: In this very body, the divine resides. You need not travel far to find it.
author: Mandukya Upanishad

text: The deepest truth is the simplest: you are divine.
author: Mandukya Upanishad

text: When you truly know who you are, all suffering ends. The Self is untouched by birth and death.
author: Mandukya Upanishad

text: To serve without motive is the highest yoga. The action itself becomes the offering.
author: Lord Krishna

text: God is not found in the temples or mosques, but in the hearts of those who seek Him with sincerity.
author: Swami Vivekananda

text: The universe is not outside of you. It is within. Know yourself, and you know all.
author: Nisargadatta Maharaj

text: Service to man is service to God. In every act of kindness, the divine is present.
author: Swami Sivananda

text: The deepest and most profound prayer is silence — for in silence, the soul speaks.
author: Ramana Maharshi

text: The fire of devotion, once lit, can never be extinguished. It burns forever in the heart of the devotee.
author: Sri Aurobindo

text: Sadhana is not a task to complete — it is a way of being. Every moment is practice.
author: Sadhguru

text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom. The rest is simply detail.
author: Adi Shankaracharya

text: The divine is not something to be sought. It is what you already are. Awaken to it.
author: Paramahansa Yogananda

text: The Self is its own light.
author: Adi Shankaracharya
